# Contributing

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Kotlin/Ktor health-service scaffold from the reviewed initial import only; no authentication, ledger or product APIs are implemented.

Install Python 3.14, Git, Node 24.14.0 (see `.nvmrc`), and JDK 21, then run:

```text
python scripts/setup.py
python scripts/check_repository.py
python scripts/materialize_money_sources.py
python scripts/money_provider.py --source-root "build/source-materialization/contracts-aa8d90cb98cec9b6dd08c91b3a4d869e47362662" --strategy-file "build/source-materialization/docs-a700e639585c61a4610e7b99dbd02b2dab28bdcc/governance/test-strategy.json"
python scripts/money_provider.py --verify
python scripts/materialize_money_sources.py --verify
python -I -S -B scripts/prepare_database_admission.py prepare --fetch
python -I -S -B scripts/prepare_database_admission.py verify
python scripts/quality.py build
python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests
```

`CI` runs on standard GitHub-hosted Ubuntu for pushes and pull requests, including
forks, with read-only permissions and no repository secrets. Actions are SHA-pinned.
Workflow/config files generated here use JSON syntax, a valid YAML subset, so
the stdlib checker can validate them without installing a second parser.

Branches and small PRs remain required after the initial import. Record two
self-reviews and separate agent review. Do not request self-approval from the
only GitHub user. Apply specialist review to the changed risks. Preserve failures;
do not manufacture reports, check results or reviewer identities.

Generated setup is maintained in `PenniLogic/infra/governance`. Development builds
and tests belong in this repository as its implementation is added.
